result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred limits for CGL, E&O, cyber, and statutory workers’ compensation and requires certificates on request. It preserves the substance of the existing risk-of-loss and security provisions. However, it goes beyond the playbook by requiring all coverage to continue for one year after the term and unnecessarily reorders the existing provisions. The clause is otherwise professionally drafted, though post-termination coverage would be better limited to claims-made E&O and cyber policies, if required at all.
